author: Brenda Livan
text: I stopped wearing Libre 3+ in mid-October for this very reason. Abbott did replace 3 of them for me as they were part of the recall. Odd thing, I was getting similar false lows with several that were NOT part of the recall. 99% of the low glucose alarms were false.... with a blood number of 60-80 points higher. So now I have the 3 replaced CGMs sitting in a drawer and I honestly don't want to even bother with them anymore. Problems got significantly worse when I "upgraded" from Libre 3 to Libre 3+.  Even with the CGM, I was still sticking my finger 3-4 times a day cause the numbers always felt so off. Was great when I was first diagnosed 2 years ago... but now, not so much.
